# X-Codec2 official reference fixture

These files are generated by `tools/parity/xcodec2/dump_reference.py` from
the official `xcodec2==0.1.5` PyPI implementation and the audited public
`vokra/xcodec2` GGUF. The oracle imports and executes the official
`CodecDecoderVocos`; it is independent of the Rust forward.

The GGUF is 3.29 GB and is never generated or loaded on the maintainer Mac.
Reference generation and real consumer parity run on VAST. The committed
`manifest.json` records exact source, dependency, GGUF, and fixture hashes.

The Rust gate uses FP32 max-absolute `2e-4`, RMSE `2e-5`, and cosine
`0.999999`. These are the existing NeuCodec family bounds and are not widened
to fit X-Codec2 observations.
